description: This file contains shell script functions for platform-specific upgrade operations in an embedded Linux system, including handling of SD card upgrades, UBI partition management, device detection, and image verification.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_sdboot
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process using sdboot, including mounting partitions, writing kernel and root filesystem, and erasing rootfs.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_traverse_slotubi
methods.description: Handles UBI partition upgrade based on boot slot information.

methods.name: platform_copy_config_sdboot
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to the device when upgrading via sdboot.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Determines device type and invokes the appropriate config copy method.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the current device supports the sysupgrade process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function that dispatches the upgrade method based on device type.
